findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" does not specify the required facilities, duration, or performance criteria, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands a clear and exhaustive description.
findings.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., offices, storage, sanitation), specify the period of provision and any performance standards.

findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich specification
findings.message: The description "Boden gemäß Baugrubenprofil lösen und ausheben" lacks the required Homogenbereich (soil class) as required by the STLB‑Bau standard (DIN 18300).
findings.suggestion: Add the Homogenbereich (e.g., B1, B2) and any relevant soil parameters.

findings.title: Missing material class for frost protection layer
findings.message: The text "Frostschutzmaterial liefern und nach Vorgabe einbauen" does not state the material type, class or performance criteria (e.g., EN 13985, thermal conductivity).
findings.suggestion: Specify the frost protection material (e.g., granular, geotextile), its class and any relevant test standards.

findings.title: Ambiguous quantity for PE‑HD pipes
findings.message: The short text "PE‑HD Rohre 2 x" is vague; it is unclear whether the quantity refers to 2 m, 2 pieces, or a double‑wall pipe, which conflicts with VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: State the exact quantity (e.g., 2 Stk, length 80 m) and pipe dimensions.

findings.title: Duplicate position number with different services
findings.message: The same Ordnungszahl 2.1.2.80 is used for "Betonstahl B500B liefern" and "Schalung für Fundamente", creating a conflict and risk of double payment.
findings.suggestion: Assign a unique OZ to each service (e.g., 2.1.2.80a for steel, 2.1.2.81 for formwork).

findings.title: Missing technical data for reinforcement steel
findings.message: The description "Betonstahl B500B schneiden, biegen und einbauen" does not specify the required diameters, bend radii or tolerances, which are mandatory according to VOB/C DIN 18331.
findings.suggestion: Add required diameters, bend radii, and any certification requirements.

findings.title: Missing specifications for formwork
findings.message: The entry "Schalung für Fundamente" lacks material, type (e.g., timber, steel), and dimensions, which are required by the STLB‑Bau standard.
findings.suggestion: Specify the formwork material, panel size, and any required accessories.

findings.title: Missing description for thermal insulation work
findings.message: The long text is empty; the short text alone does not define the insulation type, thickness, attachment method or performance class, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Provide a complete description including material (e.g., EPS, XPS), thickness, thermal conductivity, and fixing method.

findings.title: Missing water exposure class for underground sealing
findings.message: The phrase "Abdichtung gemäß geltenden technischen Regeln" does not state the required Wassereinwirkungsklasse (e.g., W1.2‑E) as required by DIN 18533.
findings.suggestion: Add the required water exposure class and the specific sealing system (e.g., PMBC, EPDM).

findings.title: Vague scope for “Arbeiten nach Angabe der Bauleitung”
findings.message: The short text "Arbeiten nach Angabe der Bauleitung, ca." and the long text "Absteckung und Kontrollmessungen durchführen" are not exhaustive; the range of possible tasks is undefined, creating a risk of hidden additional services.
findings.suggestion: List all possible tasks, measurement methods, and acceptance criteria, or reference a detailed specification sheet.

findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich for topsoil removal
findings.message: The description does not specify the soil class (Homogenbereich) required for topsoil handling according to DIN 18300.
findings.suggestion: Add the Homogenbereich (e.g., B1) and any contamination criteria.

findings.title: Missing Homogenbereich for excavation
findings.message: Identical to position 2.1.1.40, the required Homogenbereich is not stated, violating the STLB‑Bau standard.
findings.suggestion: Specify the Homogenbereich and any relevant geotechnical parameters.

findings.title: Duplicate site establishment position
findings.message: Position 2.1.4.50 repeats the content of 2.1.1.10, leading to a potential double payment and conflict with VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6.
findings.suggestion: Consolidate the two positions or clearly differentiate the scope (e.g., separate phases).
